tools.name: website_audit
tools.description: Audit a small-business website the way a door-to-door web designer would: does it load, is it https, mobile viewport, page weight, dead or parked domain, social page standing in for a real site. Returns a verdict (NO_SITE, SOCIAL_ONLY, BAD_SITE, DEAD_SITE, GOOD_SITE) and notes.
